title: SENT TOMORROW · Part 5 (Finale)
gemini_style: teenage girl telling it fast, close to the mic, tense and real

vo_open.text: My reflection pressed its hand on the glass. And the glass cracked.
vo_open.cap: My reflection pressed its hand on the glass. And the glass *cracked.*
vo_open.de: Mein Spiegelbild drückte die Hand ans Glas. Und das Glas bekam Risse.
vo_open.es: Mi reflejo apoyó la mano en el cristal. Y el cristal se agrietó.
vo_open.fr: Mon reflet a posé sa main sur la vitre. Et la vitre s’est fissurée.
vo_open.tts: My reflection pressed its hand on the glass... <short pause> and the glass CRACKED.

vo.text: One last text from me. Break the glass. She can only come through glass.
vo.cap: One last text from *me.* Break the glass. She can only come through *glass.*
vo.de: Eine letzte Nachricht von mir. Zerbrich das Glas. Sie kommt nur durch Glas.
vo.es: Un último mensaje mío. Rompe el cristal. Solo puede pasar a través del cristal.
vo.fr: Un dernier message de moi. Casse la vitre. Elle ne peut passer que par le verre.
vo.tts: <gasp> One last text from me. <short pause> Break the glass. She can only come through glass.

vo.text: So I grabbed the fire extinguisher. And I smashed it.
vo.cap: So I grabbed the *fire extinguisher.* And I *smashed* it.
vo.de: Also packte ich den Feuerlöscher. Und schlug zu.
vo.es: Así que agarré el extintor. Y lo rompí.
vo.fr: Alors j’ai attrapé l’extincteur. Et je l’ai brisée.
vo.tts: So I grabbed the fire extinguisher... <breath> and I SMASHED it.
vo.style: fierce, determined, shouting the last word

vo.text: At sunrise, we were safe. I typed one text to myself. Don't open the door. And hit send.
vo.cap: At *sunrise,* we were safe. I typed one text to *myself.* Don't open the door. And hit *send.*
vo.de: Bei Sonnenaufgang waren wir sicher. Ich schrieb mir selbst eine Nachricht. Mach die Tür nicht auf. Und drückte auf Senden.
vo.es: Al amanecer estábamos a salvo. Me escribí un mensaje a mí misma. No abras la puerta. Y lo envié.
vo.fr: Au lever du soleil, on était en sécurité. Je me suis écrit un message. N’ouvre pas la porte. Et j’ai appuyé sur envoyer.
vo.tts: <sigh> At sunrise, we were safe. <short pause> I typed one text to myself... Don't open the door. <short pause> And hit send.

vo.text: But in the car window, Mom's reflection was still smiling.
vo.cap: But in the car window, *Mom's* reflection was still *smiling.*
vo.de: Aber in der Autoscheibe lächelte Mamas Spiegelbild immer noch.
vo.es: Pero en la ventanilla del coche, el reflejo de mamá seguía sonriendo.
vo.fr: Mais dans la vitre de la voiture, le reflet de maman souriait encore.
vo.tts: But in the car window... <short pause> Mom's reflection was still smiling.
